title: Pure Solfachord
summary: Solfachord cards only, with generic staples. The 2025 trio leads: Solfachord Primoa searches any Solfachord card and makes their effects unnegatable once both Scales are set, Solfachord Solfegia summons itself and brings out another Solfachord from the hand, Extra Deck or GY, and Solfachord Happiness searches two Pendulums with different Scales or grants a second Pendulum Summon. Every Pendulum Summon is shielded by the Scales' effects, and the GranSolfachord Links negate on the opponent's turn. The page's end board adds Baronne de Fleur and Apollousa, both Forbidden in the TCG, and Odd-Eyes Vortex Dragon from another archetype, so the Extra Deck here is the two Solfachord Links plus generic Links.
main: Solfachord Primoa
Newest starter: searches any Solfachord card; with an odd and an even Scale set, their effects cannot be negated.
Solfachord Solfegia
Summons itself, then summons another Solfachord from the hand, Extra Deck or GY.
DoSolfachord Cutia
Scale 8: searches a Solfachord Pendulum when summoned.
SolSolfachord Gracia
Scale 4: searches a Solfachord Spell/Trap when summoned.
FaSolfachord Fancia
Scale 5: sends a Solfachord Pendulum face-up to the Extra Deck.
LaSolfachord Angelia
Scale 3: tributes a Pendulum to summon one 2 Scales away from the Deck.
MiSolfachord Eliteia
Scale 6: bounces a Spell/Trap when summoned.
ReSolfachord Dreamia
Scale 7: summons itself with a Solfachord Scale set.
TiSolfachord Beautia
Scale 2: banishes a monster or Spell/Trap when it leaves the field.
DoSolfachord Coolia
Scale 1 boss: negates up to two cards and destroys an activating monster.
Solfachord Happiness
Newest Spell: searches two Pendulums with different Scales or grants a second Pendulum Summon.
Solfachord Elegance
Sets both Scales from the Deck or draws 2.
Solfachord Harmonia
Field Spell: recovers from the Extra Deck, raises a Scale, or destroys a card.
Solfachord Scale
Resets a Scale, summons from the hand, or wipes their face-up cards.
Solfachord Symphony
Quick-Play: destroys a card and summons a GranSolfachord from the Extra Deck.
Solfachord Musica
Revives a face-up Pendulum from the Extra Deck or destroys a card.
Solfachord Formal
Counter Trap: makes your Pendulums unaffected by an opposing effect.
extra: Link-2: swaps Pendulums between the hand and Extra Deck and searches by Scale.
Link-3: negates on their turn by summoning an odd-Scale Solfachord from the Pendulum Zone.
